source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.official_english: Expert: Housing market has basically bottomed out
topics.why_hot: Housing is a key economic and livelihood topic, and an expert view on the market bottoming out draws wide attention.
topics.share_angle: Present it as an expert view rather than confirmed fact, and note that supporting data is needed beyond the headline.
